message: Vector Rebel 3.2.86: Original Daily Captain Check restored; live C-shift pilot is not an inspection history substitute.
releaseNotes: Restore the original Daily Captain Check after the C-shift pilot displayed no PPE data. Open the saved native two-month item report if present, otherwise launch the original read-only Captain Set and Vector Item Log audit. For today's C-shift tour, previously Captain-confirmed Rebel Command duty is preselected when shift, identity and tour match, without overwriting manual changes. Owner-specific PPE inventory discovery can preserve other owners' verified rows. BC pilot remains separate and its empty inventory must not be treated as proof of no missing inspections. No official inspections or CrewSense edits are made by the history reader. Live authenticated field acceptance is still required.
